title: Cadmies Session Export
definition: The practice of immediately exporting the CAR file after every harvest session in the CADMIES knowledge system to ensure block data persistence across Paperspace sessions.

difficulty_levels.beginner: In the CADMIES knowledge system, it's important to create a CAR file after every harvest session to keep block data safe and accessible across different Paperspace sessions.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The CADMIES knowledge system requires the immediate creation of a CAR file after every harvest session to ensure the persistence of block data across different Paperspace sessions, preventing data loss due to machine swaps and other issues.
difficulty_levels.expert: The CADMIES knowledge system employs the CAR file for block data persistence across Paperspace sessions. The practice of immediately exporting the CAR file after every harvest session ensures the long-term preservation of the system's data, even during machine swaps and other issues.

extra_fields.insight: CAR file export is crucial for ensuring the long-term persistence of the CADMIES knowledge system's data across different Paperspace sessions.
